subtitle: Process Overview

stat_cards.description: Process Owner, AI Agent, and Finance Team collaborate across design, development, and review phases.

stack_layers.label: Discovery
stack_layers.description: Process Owner defines R2R scope and identifies AI intervention opportunities across the cycle.

stack_layers.label: Design
stack_layers.description: AI Agent develops detailed workflow specifications and automation logic for each intervention point.

stack_layers.label: Documentation
stack_layers.description: Process Owner synthesizes findings into point of view note with business case and implementation roadmap.

stack_layers.label: Validation
stack_layers.description: Finance Team reviews, validates, and approves proposed agentic AI interventions before implementation planning.

title: Role Mandates and Accountability
bullets: Process Owner: Define R2R scope, identify opportunities, develop POV documentation, and drive stakeholder alignment.
AI Agent: Design workflow specifications and automation logic based on identified intervention opportunities.
Finance Team: Review findings, validate business case, and approve proposed interventions for implementation.

rows: Define R2R cycle scope and touchpoints
R2R cycle scope document → AI intervention map
AI intervention map → AI workflow specifications
AI workflow specifications → Point of view note
Point of view note → Validated point of view document

column_cards.heading: Operational Efficiency
column_cards.body: Agentic AI reduces manual intervention across R2R touchpoints, enabling faster close cycles and freeing Finance Team capacity for higher-value analysis and strategic planning.

column_cards.heading: Process Control Strengthening
column_cards.body: Automated workflows enforce consistent control execution, reduce human error, and provide audit-ready documentation of every intervention point across the full Record to Report cycle.

column_cards.heading: Stakeholder Alignment
column_cards.body: Case-led point of view documentation grounds recommendations in Apollo Tyres' specific R2R context, enabling Finance Team validation and executive approval before implementation.

title: Recommended Next Actions
bullets: 1. Conduct R2R scope mapping workshop with Process Owner and Finance Team to validate cycle boundaries and identify initial intervention candidates.
2. Develop detailed AI intervention map using case-led approach; prioritize high-impact, low-complexity automation opportunities for Phase 1 pilot.
3. Schedule Finance Team validation review; obtain formal approval on point of view findings and implementation roadmap before proceeding to design phase.
